title: 第18章 钻杀第19章 抉择
slug: 肉身成圣从养生太极开始
content_zh:
就在夏柒柒心里感叹之际，赫墨在听到夏柒柒此话，只觉得心头另一半阴郁顿时消失殆尽了。
从封印被破，到元婴老头和上古战魔交锋，这一切看似很长，实际上发生在电光火石之间。
如此一来，卓越如今已是兵强马壮，接下来除了九里岗的项目之外，可以图谋别的区块了。
伏隆赶上去，一掌拍在伏无生的天灵盖上，当场把他打得脑浆迸流。
“这条路可能走不通！”
刘秋兰有些失望，她缓缓收工，准备放弃融合。
可就在这时，极寒之气的烙印游到了她的灵海里，化成了一颗种子，烙印还在成长，所化的种子看上去有些残破，但并不影响它发挥决定性的作用。
“汉桑，你怎么可以怀疑我说谎！
绝对没有的事！”
看着王汉的目光，琦玉就像被踩到尾巴的猫一般。
立刻大声说道，是怎么也不愿承认自己是个暴力的人。
青木也想不出为什么，但他总觉得还应该再进去看看，总有一种莫名的熟悉的东西在勾引着他的内心。
这种东西比直觉还要来得莫名其妙，就像潜伏在他脑中的怪物，而这里的精神力场被隔断了，所以不会是外部的精神影响。
最重要的是，之前他便一直调查这这个逍遥教的事情，最近，更是查出了，逍遥教教主乃是一名年轻男子，年纪莫约三十岁，生的极其俊美，武功高强。
他们为什么会死在这里？渊叔他们一定经过这里，周围搏斗的痕迹是那么明显，但是没有枪弹的痕迹，就像是一场突然袭击，但走在明处的明明是渊叔他们，为什么死在这里的会是他们三个？
“呜……”
被王汉拍了一下，双头狼顿时焉了，也不管挡在前面的薇薇安，白色脑袋对着伤痕累累的野猪就呼出了一口带着白色光晕的雾气，将薇薇安和野猪笼罩住，野猪身上的伤口顿时以肉眼可见的速度恢复起来。
看到她双眸中的七彩之色消失之后，杨毅云心里松了口气，知道危机结束了。
“我给了你，那我岂不是白抢了六万灵石。”
凌天没有直接答应，而是直接回了一句这。

看到了冷寐影的情况，诸葛独寒方才暗自松了一口气，虽然他不懂医术，但是他却认得跟冷寐影的炼药术不相上下的宝贝。
陈恒之心中许下诺言，他伸手放在父亲的面颊上，鲜血汩汩流下，他抚摸在血痕上，轻轻抚着父亲的双眼，想要让父亲闭上眼睛。
“呵呵～终于忍不住了么～”
杨毅云丝毫没将八个大罗放在眼里自语说话。
随着基地车的前半部分都已经进入了水中，就在这时，从基地车的车头处开始变形，迅速变化为了一艘流线型的船艇，轰一声落在了水中，溅起了无数浪花。
“现在，你们只要有知情者说出谁是主谋，谁要见这个男人，就可以免责！”
孙夫人上前对着那一众丫鬟嬷嬷劝说。
content_en:
Just as Xia Qiqi was sighing in her heart, when He Mo heard Xia Qiqi's words, he felt that the other half of the gloom in his heart suddenly disappeared.
From the breaking of the seal to the confrontation between the old man Nascent Soul and the ancient war demon, everything seems to be very long, but in fact it happens in the blink of an eye.
As a result, Zhuo Zhuo is now in a strong position, and in addition to the Jiuligang project, it can plan for other areas.
Fulong caught up and slapped Fu Wusheng's Tianling Gai with his palm, beating him until his brains burst out on the spot.
"This road may not work!"
Liu Qiulan was a little disappointed. She slowly called it a day and was ready to give up on the fusion.
But at this moment, the brand of extremely cold air swam into her spiritual sea and turned into a seed. The brand was still growing. The seed looked a little broken, but it did not affect its decisive role.
"Han Sang, how can you suspect me of lying!
Absolutely nothing! "
Looking at Wang Han's eyes, Saitama was like a cat whose tail had been stepped on.
He immediately said loudly, unwilling to admit that he was a violent person.
Aoki couldn't figure out why, but he always felt that he should go in and take a look again. There was always something inexplicably familiar that seduced his heart.
This kind of thing is more inexplicable than intuition, like a monster lurking in his mind, and the mental force field here is cut off, so it cannot be an external mental influence.
The most important thing is that he has been investigating the Xiaoyao Sect before, and recently, he found out that the leader of the Xiaoyao Sect is a young man, about thirty years old, extremely handsome, and highly skilled in martial arts.
Why did they die here? Uncle Yuan and the others must have passed by here. The traces of fighting around them were so obvious, but there were no traces of bullets. It was like a sudden attack, but it was clearly Uncle Yuan and the others who were walking in the open. Why were the three of them dead here?
"Woo..."
After being patted by Wang Han, the two-headed wolf suddenly stopped. Regardless of Vivian who was blocking the front, the white head exhaled a white halo of mist towards the scarred wild boar, covering Vivian and the wild boar. The wounds on the wild boar immediately recovered at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After seeing the colorful colors in her eyes disappear, Yang Yiyun breathed a sigh of relief, knowing that the crisis was over.
"If I gave it to you, wouldn't I have robbed 60,000 spiritual stones in vain?"
Ling Tian did not agree directly, but replied directly.
Seeing Leng Meiying's condition, Zhuge Duhan secretly breathed a sigh of relief. Although he didn't understand medical skills, he recognized a treasure that was as good as Leng Meiying's alchemy skills.
Chen Hengzhi made a promise in his heart. He put his hand on his father's cheek. The blood was flowing down. He touched the blood stain and gently stroked his father's eyes, trying to make his father close his eyes.
"Haha~ I finally couldn't bear it anymore~"
Yang Yiyun said to himself without paying any attention to the eight great Luo.
As the front half of the base vehicle had already entered the water, at this moment, the front of the base vehicle began to deform, quickly transforming into a streamlined boat, which landed in the water with a bang, splashing countless waves.
"Now, as long as you have an insider who can tell who is the mastermind and who wants to see this man, you will be exempted from liability!"
Mrs. Sun stepped forward to persuade the maids and grandmothers.
